text: 🇲🇽🛢️ 84% of gas stations now sell diesel under 27 pesos. "Over 8,600 stations are complying with the voluntary price agreement." — Iván Escalante, Profeco chief National average: 27.05 pesos/liter. A public map, updated daily, names the stations breaking the deal. The basic basket also held: cheapest at 736.50 in Reynosa, all monitored stores under the 910-peso cap.

🇲🇽🚴 Isaac del Toro: first Mexican ever on a Tour de France podium. "I don't think these kids spent their days on the phone." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, on Mexico's athletes Del Toro finished 3rd overall at the 2026 Tour and won stage 2. Mexico also leads the Central American and Caribbean Games medal table in Santo Domingo: 43 medals, 16 gold.
banner: DEL TORO: FIRST MEXICAN ON TOUR PODIUM

text: 🧠🇲🇽 "Twenty years ago we could spend 2.5 minutes on a screen task; now it's 47 seconds before we get distracted." "The adolescent brain: a powerful accelerator at 15, brakes still developing until 25." — Dr. Lucía Magis Weinberg, University of Washington More screen time in adolescence is linked to thinning in brain regions and eroded attention. Cellphone access before age 12 is associated with cognitive development issues.

📱🇲🇽 New generations will lose 20 years of their lives to social media. "It's not just that a child becomes apathetic — their brain may already be functioning differently." — Tania Jiménez, addiction prevention specialist Under dopamine overstimulation the brain stops producing it and hides receptors, specialists explained at the mañanera. Recovery is possible: neuroplasticity.
banner: GEN Z: 20 YEARS LOST TO SOCIAL MEDIA

text: 📱🇲🇽 "Algorithms obey the market — that's how they're designed." "There are interests auctioning our attention in real time. That's why inflated controversies thrive, divisive debate is rewarded, and intolerance grows." — Mario Delgado, Secretary of Public Education Mexico opened a national discussion on screens, social media, and children. France just regulated social media access for under-15s; each country will reach its own definition.

🇲🇽⚖️ "This kind of education is not permitted in Mexico." "Militarized education is not allowed; it is not contemplated in current legislation." — Mario Delgado, Secretary of Public Education The SEP will review every school operating a militarized model and asked states to audit permits. The move follows the Dafne Zapata case and the discovery of militarized academies in Tamaulipas.
banner: "THIS KIND OF EDUCATION IS NOT PERMITTED"

text: 🇲🇽🌎 "There is no campaign against any country or government in the world." "What exists, on the contrary, is an orchestrated campaign against our government." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, responding to Javier Milei Milei accused Mexico and Brazil of financing an "anti-Argentina" campaign during the 2026 World Cup. Sheinbaum: false. Mexico doesn't meddle in other countries' affairs — and asks for the same.

🇲🇽🌎 "Democracy, democracy, democracy. Power of the people, government of the people." "It's the self-determination of peoples — whatever the people of Nicaragua decides. We always stand with democracy, in all its terms." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, on Nicaragua Asked about Daniel Ortega's announcement that there will be no more elections in Nicaragua, Sheinbaum defended self-determination. Would she apply the same in Mexico? "Here we even have recall referendums. Elections every six years."
